title: Acceptance Limits, Waiting Period and Minimum Term of the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan
content:
A plan of the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan is written to a member acting as a host, against a vehicle that carries a listing on the marketplace, and each plan sets the oldest vehicle and the highest odometer reading it accepts, the fuel types it services, the waiting period that follows enrolment and the shortest period the plan must run.

| Plan | Oldest vehicle accepted (whole years) | Highest odometer accepted (miles) | Fuel types serviced | Waiting period (calendar days) | Shortest the plan must run (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Care Essentials Plan | 14 | 150000 | gasoline, diesel, hybrid | 14 | 180 |
| Keyturn Care Routine Plan | 12 | 130000 | gasoline, diesel, hybrid | 14 | 180 |
| Keyturn Care Complete Plan | 10 | 110000 | gasoline, diesel, hybrid, battery electric | 7 | 180 |
| Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan | 8 | 90000 | gasoline, diesel, hybrid, battery electric | 3 | 180 |
| Keyturn Care Fleet Plan | 12 | 175000 | gasoline, diesel, hybrid, battery electric | 3 | 365 |
| Keyturn Care Electric Plan | 9 | 100000 | battery electric | 7 | 180 |

### Points of judgement on the limits

*A gasoline vehicle nine years old with 120000 miles on the odometer.* The Keyturn Care Essentials Plan accepts it on all three counts, as do the Keyturn Care Routine Plan and the Keyturn Care Fleet Plan; the Keyturn Care Complete Plan does not, its odometer ceiling standing at 110000; the Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan does not, on either count; and the Keyturn Care Electric Plan does not, being written for battery electric vehicles alone.

*A battery electric vehicle four years old with 30000 miles on the odometer.* Every plan but the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan and the Keyturn Care Routine Plan services its fuel type, and the age and odometer limits of all six are met, so the plans open to it are the Keyturn Care Complete, Turnaround, Fleet and Electric Plans.

The widest odometer ceiling on the card, 175000 miles, belongs to the Keyturn Care Fleet Plan, which is also the only plan whose minimum term of 365 calendar days runs the whole of a term rather than the 180 calendar days the other five set.
